name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Direct Response Specialist
summary: Direct-response marketing professional with 15+ years coordinating and executing multi-channel campaigns for B2B and agency clients, translating strategy into detailed execution plans across email, paid, and CRM-driven outreach. Draft direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive measurable engagement and pipeline, and build the ROI/CAC/LTV reporting that shows what's working. Collaborate closely with internal teams and external partners to deliver complex, deadline-driven campaigns on time, using data and testing to continuously improve results.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Draft clean, specific direct-response copy, outreach sequences, and landing pages that drive engagement and pipeline for concurrent B2B clients.

Architect and deploy segmented outreach campaigns (website-visibility, missed-calls, and low-reviews campaigns) plus an automated prospect-audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts, scoring each business's digital footprint to trigger personalized outreach.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, tracking campaign-level KPIs and account health.
Design self-improving loops and evaluation frameworks to monitor campaign outputs, separating signal from noise and continuously optimizing conversion rates.
Write and publish thought-leadership content, newsletters, and educational guides tailored to each client's brand voice and audience.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments and external partners.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Produced high-converting campaign assets - landing pages, complex email sequences, conversion-focused copy - improving lead generation and pipeline.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics across 15-20 reseller accounts to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated outreach sequences that reduced onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, then handed them to the implementation team to execute.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ran full-cycle sales for a loyalty and marketing automation platform targeting SMBs, from prospecting through customer acquisition.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
